newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's ABA Motriz loan book at 1.6 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's ABA Motriz loan book at 1.6 bln pesos.

text.p: Abaco Grupo Financiero said Monday its automobile financing unit ABA Motriz Financimiento has built up a loan portfolio of 1.6 billion pesos since it started in December 1995.
"Despite the difficult situation that the economy is suffering and its recent introduction in 1995, it has had encouraging results," the banking group said in a statement.
ABA Motriz was formed out of a joint venture between the Abaco financial group, which took 51 percent, and General Motors Acceptance Corp, which took the rest.
Abaco said ABA Motriz had a loan portfolio of 1.1 billion pesos with General Motors distributors and 500 million pesos with individual clients.
